supporting_pages.title: "Go runtime environment \_|\_ App Engine standard environment \_|\_ Google\
evidence_snippets: The Go runtime for App Engine in the standard environment is declared in the app.yaml file: runtime : go VERSION Where VERSION is the Go MAJOR and MINOR version numbers.
App Engine automatically updates to new patch revisions, but won't automatically update the major version.

For example, your application might be deployed at the minor version Go 1.13.1 and be automatically updated to version 1.13.2 at a later deployment, but it won't be automatically updated to the major version Go 1.14.

Specifying a service account App Engine lets you use two types of service accounts: Per-version service account : A service account configured as the identity for a specific version of your deployed service.
If you need to use a unique identity for a version of your App Engine app when accessing other Google Cloud services or executing tasks, you can specify a user-managed service account in App Engine.
